VCO 1 is the grey-box model fitted to the 437 recordings, exact at every measured setting, with the measured pitch jitter and noise floor. VCO 2 uses the same model, since the schematic shows an identical circuit, but it was never recorded.

The LFO (a CA3080 integrator and Schmitt comparator, 0.01 to 100 Hz, rate CV at 1 V per octave), the voltage processor lag and the CA3080 VCAs are wave digital filter models built from the schematic topology and checked against ngspice. The noise generator is a bit-exact model of an MM5837 shift-register noise chip, with a white or pink setting and the WDF output network. The chip type, the LFO range and the component values come from secondary sources or are placeholders until the board's own parts list is found. The ADS envelope is behavioural. Sync resets VCO 2 on every cycle of VCO 1, or on rising edges at its Sync input when patched.

Normalled connections, as on the hardware: keyboard CV into the voltage processor, voltage processor into both VCO pitch inputs, VCOs and noise into the output VCA, LFO and envelope into the VCO VCAs. Patching an input replaces its normal. Pitch inputs are 1 V per octave, audio and LFO about ±5 V, the envelope 0 to 5 V.
